groups.why: Runs the save round-trip in no-save mode with the dana.robot auth account, so its state differs from the insert-mode rows and it stays on its own.
Runs the insert round-trip with the jooyong026 auth account, so its auth context differs from the generic crud row and grouping it could drop a check.
Runs the insert round-trip as a generic crud run with no auth account, so its context differs from the authcrud rows.
Checks that editing two rows and saving once updates both, which is a different target and expected result from single-row checks.
Checks the save round-trip for each editable column, so its scope differs from the single marker-row round-trip.
Checks that the marker row exists in the DB ledger after the success message, but its target and condition are unclear, so it stays on its own.
Checks what happens when the server is forced to fail, and the expected result (failure message shown, no success message) differs from the other rows.
